context: Teacher and two students reflect after a tough exam
purpose: Teach: とくに/きわめて/あくまで/どんなに/仮に/たいへん/だんだん/なぜなら

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日のテスト、たいへんでしたね。とくに後半の長文読解は難しかったと思います。
lines.en: Today's exam was quite tough, wasn't it. Especially the long reading section in the second half, I think.
lines.style: Warm teacherly opening with sympathetic measured polite tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本当にすごく難しかったです。なぜなら、見たことのない文法がいくつも出てきたからで……。
lines.en: It was really super hard. Because there were several grammar points I'd never seen before...
lines.style: Slightly defeated university student trailing off with tired sigh

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちもムリだった〜。だんだん頭がぼーっとしてきて、最後は完全に勘で書いたし。
lines.en: I totally couldn't do it either. My head got foggier and foggier, and at the end I just went purely on gut feeling.
lines.style: Casual teen complaining with playful exasperated whine drawl

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 勘も大事ですよ。でも、点数はあくまで通過点です。仮に今回だめでも、次に活かせばいいんです。
lines.en: Intuition matters too. But scores are ultimately just a waypoint. Even if this time didn't go well, you can use it for next time.
lines.style: Gentle reassuring teacher pivoting to encouragement with softening smile

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そう言っていただけると、少し気が楽になります。きわめて落ち込んでいたので……。
lines.en: Hearing you say that makes me feel a bit better. I was extremely down about it...
lines.style: Quiet grateful exhale with shoulders relaxing visibly now

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でもさ、どんなに勉強しても本番で緊張するんだよね……先生、なんかコツあります?
lines.en: But like, no matter how much I study I get nervous in the real thing... Sensei, any tips?
lines.style: Teen leaning in curiously with hopeful searching upward inflection

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 深呼吸ですね。焦った時こそ、一度息を整えれば落ち着きますよ。
lines.en: Deep breathing. Especially when you're panicked, taking one breath to steady yourself will calm you down.
lines.style: Calm advisory delivery with steady reassuring breath-paced rhythm

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど……次は焦らず、自分のペースを保てるように頑張ります。
lines.en: I see... next time I'll try not to panic and keep my own pace.
lines.style: Thoughtful nodding agreement with renewed focused quiet resolve
